method: FM3_SHOT_LOAD.py --load (Remote Control): edit-buffer load (7F 00) of one generated preset, then a read-only fn=0x1F bulk read of every test block (all words, all channels) compared word for word; the user then read the written controls from FM3-Edit screenshots and front-panel photos. Nothing stored or set.

parts.name: SHOT T23 AMP DYN
notes: No control named Dynamic Depth / Dynamic Presence on any Amp page in FM3-Edit (A: Power Amp, Dynamics; D: Ideal, Pwr Tubes + CF, Power Supply, Speaker) nor on the FM3 front panel (user report).
Power Amp 'Presence Frequency' A shows 1.000 (DYNPRES A raw 0) and Ideal 'Depth' D shows 0.00 (DYNDEPTH D raw 65534): neither is the written word.
Device holds all 8 written words (fn=0x1F read-back). Status stays unverified-taper; composer must not use DISTORT_DYNDEPTH / DISTORT_DYNPRES.

summary.result: DISTORT_DYNDEPTH and DISTORT_DYNPRES are stored and read back exactly but have no control in FM3-Edit or on the FM3 front panel; they stay unverified-taper and the composer must not write them.
